name: nested-package-without-root-manifest
description: A run at a root that holds no package.json reads the manifest of each nested package that holds a compiler configuration, so it applies the convention rows that manifest declares and judges its dependencies, as a run at that package does. A string at the stryker row's selection key roots nothing, so a hook only a test calls is reported, a file the vitest row's setupFiles names is test code, and a development dependency nothing runs is reported. A command a workflow step of the root runs is a use of the dependency of a nested package that declares it.
